cards.name: 短語_獨特的音樂風格
cards.scene: A child wearing headphones with eyes closed, smiling, surrounded by magical swirling music notes in unusual shapes and soft colors (leaf shapes, little clouds, stars) floating out of a gentle animated forest scene; dreamy and very unique feeling.

cards.name: 短語_明亮的燈光效果
cards.scene: A school stage where bright spotlights shine down, making the whole stage glow and sparkle; beams of light clearly visible; a small child on stage looking up at the bright lights in amazement.

cards.name: 短語_深刻的情感表達
cards.scene: A girl on stage reading a letter aloud with deep feeling, hand on her heart, a tear on her cheek; the audience in front is moved, some wiping their eyes.

cards.name: 短語_困難的舞蹈動作
cards.scene: A boy practicing a very hard dance move: balancing upside down on one hand while spinning; a dance teacher beside him ready to help; a mat on the floor.

cards.name: 情境_可愛的卡通人物
cards.scene: Children sitting on a carpet watching a TV screen; on the screen is a round chubby little bear cartoon character with big sparkling eyes waving; the children hold their cheeks and smile because it is so cute.

cards.name: 情境_精采的動畫電影
cards.scene: Inside a movie theater, a family and kids watching an exciting animated movie on the big screen (colorful adventure scene with a flying dragon), eyes wide open, leaning forward, some clapping excitedly; popcorn in hands.

cards.name: 情境_好聽的背景音樂
cards.scene: A girl wearing headphones, listening to music from a tablet showing an animation scene, smiling happily, eyes half closed, humming, little music notes floating around her head.

cards.name: 情境_困難的舞蹈動作
cards.scene: In a dance classroom, an older brother tries a difficult spinning handstand dance move, wobbling and about to fall onto a soft mat, sweat drops on his face; a younger sister watching worriedly.
